title: Senior Talent Acquisiton
description:
Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

We are seeking a seasoned Talent Acquisition professional to serve as a strategic partner to the business, leading the full-cycle recruitment process with a consultative and data-driven approach. This role requires strong stakeholder management, market insight, and the ability to translate business needs into effective hiring strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, aligning talent needs with business objectives and team dynamics
  • Design and implement innovative attraction strategies tailored to role complexity, market conditions, and candidate profiles
  • Lead structured intake meetings to define success profiles and ensure clarity on job requirements
  • Represent the company at networking events and industry forums to strengthen employer brand and talent pipeline
  • Proactively source and engage top talent through multiple channels, ensuring quality and speed of delivery
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance candidate experience, operational efficiency, and data accuracy
  • Provide market insights and recruitment metrics to support decision-making and workforce planning

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, either in-house or agency, within a corporate environment
  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to influence and guide hiring managers
  • Expertise in technical or engineering recruitment and familiarity with national hiring dynamics
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication skills and business acumen to navigate complex organizational structures
  • Bachelor's degree in Administration, Psychology, Human Resources or related field
  • Bilingual in English or Spanish
  • Minimum of 5 years in similar roles with demonstrated impact
  • Experience with Workday or similar ATS platforms is a plus

title: Sales Strategy Manager (SMB)
description:
About US:

Keeta is an independent brand of Meituan, the world's largest tech-driven retail company. We focus on food and consumer product delivery services in international markets with the mission: "We help people eat better, live better".

Established in March 2010, Meituan has helped transform the supply and demand of service and product retail across the digital landscape.

As Meituan and Keeta continue to increase R&D investment and advance in new technologies, we uphold a customer-centric approach, working with our partners to provide quality services to customers.

What You'll Do:

1. Sales Target Management: Break down the SMB team's business objectives and identify key sales indicators that impact the team's ability to achieve these targets. Establish a target management system and utilize efficient data tools and organizational methods to manage the SMB team's daily, weekly, and monthly sales goals.

2. Operational Analysis: Utilize inputs from industry, competitive, and merchant information to gain insights into franchise brand growth and competitive opportunity points.

3.Sales strategy development: Develop a sales strategy by identifying growth opportunities through analysis and prospecting, and create a clear execution path.

4. Project Management: Utilize project management to ensure the successful implementation of key business goals and strategies. Mobilize resources from the strategy, product, and operations teams to effectively support the SMB team in achieving its business goals.

What We Need From You:

1. Experience: more than 2 years of experience in merchant operations, promotion preparations, and sales team operations.

2. Data analysis skills: proficient with various analysis software, capable of conducting multi-dimensional analysis and making informed business judgments.

3. Market insight: information sensitivity to the market and industry, able to capture development trends, and formulate strategies.

4. Project management ability: good at communication and expression, strong coordination, team consciousness, and organizational ability.

5. English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

The following are preferred:

1. Experience in the food delivery industry and the local-based service industry is preferred.

2. Proficient in using SQL or other data analysis tools.

3. Experience in merchant operations/strategy operations/product operations preferred.

What Make This Role Exciting:

1. A startup team with plenty of opportunities to participate in core projects for rapid growth.

2. Experiencing different countries, languages, and cultures.

title: Sugar Trader
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we've put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We're a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come.

Are you passionate about commodities and international trade? GAR Brazil, part of a fast-growing global trading group, is looking for a Trader to join our sugar team. You'll work closely with colleagues in Brazil, Singapore, and the Netherlands, supporting origination, trading, and distribution of sugar worldwide.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Support senior traders and take part in daily commercial decisions
  • Trade, manage, and report sugar positions, including futures and FX hedges
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers
  • Coordinate operational, financial, and reporting activities
  • Prepare trade documentation, contracts, invoices, and export memos
  • Assist with international trade routines, logistics, and ad-hoc tasks
  • Monitor and report risks, ensuring smooth communication with internal teams

Requirements :

  • 3+ years' experience in sugar trading or commodities
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Economics, Supply Chain, or related field
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and value-creation skills
  • Excellent English; additional languages a plus
  • Customer-focused, proactive, and results-oriented
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Who You Are:

A humble, curious, and hands-on professional who thrives in a fast-paced international environment. You are adaptable, meticulous, entrepreneurial, and able to manage multiple priorities while building strong relationships across teams.

Why Join Us?

Be part of a young, ambitious, and dynamic team shaping global sugar trading. Your work will make a real impact on our growth and international operations.

We offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)

Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: Senior Art Director
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please submit your resume in English.

We are seeking an Art Director to join our Branding team and play a pivotal role in crafting creative ads and evolving the visual presence of our brand in Brazil. This position is crucial to ensuring that our campaigns are visually striking and culturally resonant, helping us establish a strong foothold in the Brazilian market. If you are passionate about creating captivating visuals and have experience leading high-level creative projects, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the creative visual concepts for entire campaigns, working closely with the content team.
  • Create impactful key visuals that align with the company's marketing strategies.
  • Create high-conversion ad creatives—such as short videos, image-text formats, interactive ads, and H5 pages—based on user psychology, industry trends, and market hot topics.
  • Lead the development and localization of the brand in Brazil, adapting it to the cultural and aesthetic context of the country.
  • Guide and lead other design team members in various projects, ensuring visual consistency and excellence.
  • Design materials for different channels, including digital media, social networks, websites, print materials, and Out Of Home (OOH) media.
  • Manage the creative process from conception to final production, maintaining deadlines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure visual guidelines align with brand objectives.
  • Stay updated with design trends, technology, and industry innovations, applying relevant insights to projects.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in Marketing, Advertising, Visual Design, Journalism, or related fields;
  • Strong business English communication skills;
  • Proven experience as an Art Director or similar role in crafting visual campaigns and key visuals;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing strategic creative skills and visual aesthetics;
  • Experience in leading and mentoring design teams and collaborating with content strategists;
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian culture, aesthetics, and market trends;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in dynamic environments;
  • Proficiency in design software and visual creation tools;
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong ability to work as part of a team.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.

Key Responsibilities

Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.

Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.

Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Rider Experience Research Expert
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. Job Responsibilities:

Lead Rider Experience Research Initiatives:

  • Regularly produce rider experience research reports that clearly present the current status, trends, and improvement directions of rider experience, providing data support for departmental decision-making.

Establish and Monitor Experience Indicators:

  • Guided by core indicators such as NPS, establish an indicator monitoring and analysis mechanism.
  • Track indicator fluctuations on a weekly/monthly basis, promptly identify anomalies, and investigate root causes.

Drive Cross-Functional Solutions:

Job Requirements:

  • Possess solid data analysis skills, capable of independently completing data extraction, cleaning, and analysis, and adept at identifying problems and opportunities from data.
  • Possess professional questionnaire design skills, able to create targeted and highly reliable/valid questionnaires based on research objectives, and have excellent report writing abilities.
  • Possess excellent cross-departmental communication and collaboration skills, able to effectively drive different teams to solve problems collaboratively, and have strong project execution capabilities and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Have empathy for the rider community, be able to think from the rider's perspective, understand the actual needs and pain points of riders in delivery fulfillment, and possess strong problem-solving skills and innovative awareness.

Position Highlights:

  • Opportunity to contribute to the rapid global expansion of Meituan's delivery business and experience accelerated professional growth.
  • Collaborate with a dynamic, international, and fast-paced team focused on innovation and operational excellence.

title: Analista Sr - Qualidade Pesquisa Clínica - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D'Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos cujo objetivo é contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional, desenvolvimento tecnológico e inovação na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D'Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada da América Latina.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros. A partir de 2022, passou também a investir em Ensino através da Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, que conta atualmente com cursos de graduação em Radiologia, Enfermagem, Psicologia e Técnico de Enfermagem.

Requisitos

A área de Qualidade em Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por assegurar que todos os processos relacionados a ensaios clínicos sejam conduzidos conforme normas nacionais e internacionais, garantindo a integridade científica dos dados, a segurança dos participantes e a aderência regulatória. Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.

- Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;

- Pós-graduação ou especialização em Pesquisa Clínica, Gestão da Qualidade ou Auditoria em Saúde;

- Espanhol técnico para interface com centros da América Latina;

- Desejável experiência consolidada em auditorias de pesquisa clínica.

- Desejável conhecimento avançado em ICH-GCP, legislação nacional (RDC 9/2015, Res. CNS 466/2012,

510/2016) e boas práticas de auditoria.

- Desejável experiência prévia com auditorias de sistemas e fornecedores. Capacidade de análise crítica e visão estratégica. Inglês avançado (oral e escrito), para conduzir auditorias e relatórios em âmbito internacional

Atividades

- Planejar, coordenar e executar auditorias de alta complexidade em todas as fases dos estudos clínicos.

- Elaborar relatórios executivos de auditoria, com recomendações estratégicas e planos de mitigação de risco.

- Liderar follow-up de CAPAs (ações corretivas e preventivas), avaliando impacto e eficácia das medidas implementadas.

- Atuar como mentor técnico para analistas plenos e juniores da equipe de auditoria.

- Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e revisão de políticas corporativas e POPs relacionados à auditoria e à qualidade.

- Participar de fóruns internos e externos de qualidade, representando a área em discussões regulatórias e estratégicas.

- Monitorar indicadores-chave de qualidade e propor iniciativas de melhoria contínua na gestão de auditorias.

title: Technical Project Engineer
description:
About Invisto

Invisto is a real estate investment platform focused on urban infill developments in the U.S., specializing in high-end single-family homes in desirable, established neighborhoods in Florida — including Winter Park, Orlando, and Tampa.

One of our key differentiators is our commitment to architecture and design. We work with a team of experienced in-house and external architects and designers to develop our projects. Our close collaboration with U.S.-based construction teams and American engineers ensures full integration across disciplines. We also stay connected to the cutting edge of American residential design — constantly monitoring trends, influencers, and the preferences of high-end homebuyers.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and driven Civil Engineer to join our high-end residential design team in Florida (USA).

This is a unique opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating closely with architects, engineers, and local consultants to bring exceptional homes to life in some of Florida's most prestigious neighborhoods.

The professional will be responsible for supporting the technical development, 3D modeling, and coordination of all project disciplines, ensuring that every solution aligns with the defined scope, quality standards, and local building codes.

We seek someone with strong analytical skills, solid technical background, and a construction-oriented mindset, capable of anticipating design conflicts, proposing smart solutions, and contributing to the excellence of our residential projects.

Main responsibilities

  • Review and coordinate architectural, structural, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) plans.
  • Develop and/or review the 3D modeling of complementary disciplines, ensuring proper coordination and clash detection across all systems.
  • Ensure full alignment and compatibility between all design disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Follow up on outstanding items with external designers, engineers, and suppliers.
  • Provide technical guidance to the architectural team during project development.
  • Support the construction team with technical input during field execution.
  • Assist in technical decisions related to finishes, materials, and equipment.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
  • Advanced English.
  • Experience in development and coordination of construction projects.
  • Solid knowledge of applicable codes and technical standards.
  • Strong communication skills, organizational ability, and proactivity.
  • Experience with high-end residential projects and grading projects would be an advantage.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a reference in urban infill development in the U.S.
  • A learning-driven environment with direct collaboration between U.S. and Brazil-based teams.
  • Real potential for international career growth.
  • A dynamic, high-performance, entrepreneurial culture.
  • Hybrid work model: remote flexibility combined with in-office presence in São Paulo/SP.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Senior Support Specialist to provide advanced technical support for users and systems within a corporate IT environment. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID (Azure AD), and user support through ticketing systems. This professional will also handle basic Windows and Linux server maintenance and perform network troubleshooting as needed. The role involves ensuring service stability, maintaining system integrity, and collaborating with infrastructure and security teams to improve operational efficiency and end-user experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for users, resolving incidents and service requests via the ticketing system.
  • Administer and maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, and access permissions in Entra ID (Azure Active Directory). Perform basic maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Windows and Linux servers. Support network-related issues such as connectivity, DHCP, DNS, and VPN access.
  • Document technical procedures, configurations, and solutions. Collaborate with other IT teams on escalations, system improvements

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proven experience in IT support, preferably in corporate or enterprise environments. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID (Azure AD). Basic understanding of Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Basic knowledge of network concepts (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Experience with IT ticketing systems and customer support.
  • Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-900, MD-102, AZ-104).
  • Experience with automation tools such as PowerShell or scripting.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices or similar support frameworks.

Excellent communication skills and a proactive, problem-solving attitude.

At Shein, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

China Unicom Brazil is a subsidiary of China Unicom Global, a leading international telecommunications and ICT service provider. We deliver cross-border data connectivity, cloud and network solutions, ICT installation services, and technical support to multinational enterprises operating between China, Brazil, and the broader Latin America region. With strong global resources and local expertise, we are committed to providing reliable services, enabling digital transformation, and building a diverse, collaborative workplace.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Financial Manager; Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Tax Accounting: Calculate the Brazilian company's profits tax monthly and record the profits tax entries accordingly; prepare the Brazilian company's annual income tax return, including tax agent bidding, contract signing, providing tax calculation data, and filing tax documents.
  • Tax Planning: Lead the Brazilian tax planning work and provide relevant consulting support on Brazilian tax issues.
  • Tax Policy Support: Provide Brazilian tax policy support to the local operations team of the Brazilian company; lead the research and management document issuance of Brazilian tax policies.
  • Tax Training: Report the tax risk situation to management regularly and provide corresponding suggestions; organize regional tax training quarterly to improve the team's risk awareness and response capabilities.
  • Tax Audit and Inspection: Responsible for the external audit of the Brazilian company; lead the liaison with the superior unit for tax audits and tax statistics; regularly report on the problems found in internal and external audits and inspections and the rectification status.
  • Tax Intermediary Management: Responsible for coordinating outsourcing of tax consulting and other services in Brazil, proposing procurement needs, supervising the implementation of Brazilian tax outsourcing procurement tenders, tracking the service quality of tax outsourcing agencies monthly, and outputting evaluation results.
  • Risk Management: Ensure that the company's tax declarations and payments in Brazil strictly comply with local laws and regulations to avoid fines or legal disputes caused by violations; proactively assess potential tax risks brought about by business changes (such as new market entry, mergers and acquisitions, and business model adjustments), including key areas such as transfer pricing, permanent establishments, and indirect taxes; formulate and implement regional tax risk management policies and internal control mechanisms to ensure the accuracy of tax data and the standardization of processes, and reduce the risk of operational errors; lead the handling of tax audits, investigations, or litigation cases, communicate and coordinate with local tax authorities, control the escalation of disputes, and reduce financial losses.
  • Tax File Management: In accordance with the regulatory requirements of Brazilian government agencies, complete the organization of tax-related vouchers; revise and summarize tax-related operation manuals.
  • Complete other tasks assigned by superiors.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum Relevant Educational Degree: Bachelor's Degree
  • Relevant Major: Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analysis, Finance, Computer Science
  • Relevant Professional Knowledge or Skills: Accounting, Statistics, Computer Science
  • Preferred Relevant Work Experience: At least 3 years of experience in Brazilian tax-related work
  • Qualifications and Certifications: Intermediate Accountant or Chinese/overseas CPA/ACCA professional qualification or above, Tax Agent Qualification
  • Language Requirements: Chinese, English
  • Other Requirements: Brazilian work experience, valid work visa

title: Programador web
description:
Estamos à procura de uma Pessoa Programadora Web!

Junte-se ao nosso time e seja a peça-chave para dar vida a experiências digitais incríveis, impulsionando a presença online da nossa empresa e criando um impacto real para nossos usuários.

Resumo do Cargo

Como Pessoa Programadora Web em nossa empresa, você será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções web de alta qualidade e performance, com foco especial na plataforma WordPress. Você atuará na linha de frente da criação e manutenção do nosso site institucional e portal de notícias, transformando necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades robustas. Sua expertise será crucial para gerenciar nosso fluxo de conteúdo digital e implementar soluções de publicidade, garantindo uma plataforma escalável, atualizada e eficiente.

Como Você Terá Sucesso Neste Cargo

Você terá sucesso ao:

  • Dominar o WordPress: Customizar temas, desenvolver plugins personalizados e gerenciar a arquitetura completa do WordPress para atender às necessidades específicas do negócio.
  • Otimizar a Gestão de Conteúdo: Implementar e manter um fluxo eficiente de publicação de notícias e materiais editoriais, garantindo interface intuitiva para a equipe de conteúdo.
  • Implementar Soluções de Publicidade: Integrar e gerenciar sistemas de anúncios e monetização, assegurando a correta veiculação e acompanhamento de campanhas publicitárias.
  • Ser Colaborativa e Comunicativa: Trabalhar de forma integrada com outras pessoas desenvolvedoras, designers, equipe de conteúdo e marketing, comunicando-se com clareza sobre prazos e requisitos técnicos.
  • Manter-se Constantemente Atualizada: Mostrar curiosidade e proatividade para aprender novas tecnologias e melhores práticas, trazendo inovação contínua para nossos projetos.

Como Este Cargo se Encaixa na Organização

Nossa equipe de tecnologia é o coração que impulsiona a inovação na empresa. Como Pessoa Programadora Web especializada em WordPress, você será fundamental para nossa estratégia de comunicação digital e presença online. Seu trabalho irá sustentar diretamente nossos canais de notícias e iniciativas de marketing, impactando milhares de usuários diariamente e contribuindo para os objetivos de negócio através da publicidade digital. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo onde cada contribuição é valorizada e onde você terá a oportunidade de crescer profissionalmente junto conosco.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter sites em WordPress, incluindo customização de temas e desenvolvimento de plugins personalizados.
  • Gerenciar a estrutura e o fluxo de publicação de notícias, criando e otimizando taxonomias, campos personalizados e tipos de conteúdo.
  • Implementar e integrar soluções de publicidade no site, incluindo gestão de espaços publicitários, inserção de códigos de terceiros e configuração de ads.txt.
  • Garantir a performance, segurança e SEO dos sites em WordPress, realizando otimizações técnicas regulares.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing e conteúdo para implementar novas funcionalidades e layouts para notícias e seções especiais.
  • Realizar a manutenção e atualização de plugins e do core do WordPress, garantindo a estabilidade do ambiente.
  • Desenvolver e manter a integração do WordPress com outros sistemas da empresa através de APIs REST.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre a estrutura e funcionamento do site.
Qualificações

Competências e Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento WordPress, incluindo criação de temas e plugins personalizados.
  • Domínio de HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript e PHP.
  • Experiência com gestão de conteúdo em WordPress, incluindo Custom Post Types, Taxonomias e Campos Personalizados (ACF ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em implementação e gestão de publicidade digital (ex: Google Ad Manager, ads.txt, header bidding).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão, como Git.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, com metodologias como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Forte habilidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de colaborar efetivamente em equipe.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas, ou experiência equivalente.

Será um Diferencial:

  • Experiência com otimização de performance em WordPress.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações WordPress.
  • Experiência com e-commerce WordPress (WooCommerce).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para ambientes WordPress.
  • Portfólio com exemplos de projetos WordPress desenvolvidos.

title: Gerente Comercial (Design / Mobiliário / Arquitetura)
description:

O papel combina gestão comercial, liderança de equipe e relacionamento com arquitetos. Buscamos uma pessoa proativa, prática, hands on com energia para arregaçar as mangas quando necessário.

  • Capacitar o time para construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos e duradouros com arquitetos e especificadores locais.
  • Acompanhar de perto o pipeline de vendas da loja (via CRM), oferecendo suporte direto aos consultores em negociações, follow-ups e fechamentos.
  • Garantir um atendimento impecável a arquitetos e clientes finais
  • Gerenciar as carteiras de arquitetos e promover ações de relacionamento locais, estimulando o engajamento e a recorrência de arquitetos na base.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em vendas e liderança comercial, no setor de design, mobiliário ou arquitetura — requisito essencial.

  • Paixão por design e arquitetura.

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.

Day-to-day activities include:

  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets
  • Analysis of finance, economics, legal situations and other data affecting corporates under coverage

Requirements:

  • A minimum three to five years' experience with coverage of Brazil's corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills

About REDD:

REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging "out of the box" thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence's team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company's evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil's financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.

More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO's ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise: Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil's 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Administrar a regulação de sinistro, seguindo todas as etapas do processo (documentação, elaboração de relatórios, realização de pericias, avaliação de apólice), diagnosticando os prejuízos envolvidos e o ressarcimento com base na apólice do segurado.

FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

1. Administrar e conduzir regulações de sinistros desde a abertura, com análise prévia do local e documentos, participando as partes envolvidas, realizando reuniões, solicitando documentação e/ou perícia, analisando coberturas de apólices e laudos, apurando prejuízos e emitindo os relatórios de regulação.

2. Suportar necessidades administrativas e solicitações das corretoras, operadoras e clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas, disponibilizando e/ou solicitando documentos conforme necessidade.

3. Emitir, revisar e validar relatórios preliminares, intermediários e finais sob sua responsabilidade, revisar eventualmente relatórios de outros reguladores e direcionar relatórios emitidos para validação pela coordenação e/ou direção.

4. Alimentar o sistema, inserindo documentos, e-mails, relatórios, vistorias e perícias (fotos, atas, conclusões), horas trabalhadas (time sheet), acompanhando os alertas do sistema com relação aos prazos e resultados do ranking.

5. Monitorar status dos sinistros de acordo com a parametrização estabelecida pela empresa e controlada pela Administração da Regulação.

6. Solicitar aprovação de faturamento parcial, intermediário ou final, enviando para a seguradora a prévia do time sheet com resumo das despesas e honorários e disparando e-mail para o financeiro faturar mediante aprovação da seguradora.

EXPERIÊNCIA NA ÁREA

Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência na regulação de sinistros.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia.

CONHECIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS

  • Contrato e legislação de seguros
  • RCG – Responsabilidade Civil Geral
  • RCP – Responsabilidade Civil Profissional
  • Conhecimento prático em D&O e E&O
  • Noções de cálculos
  • Lançamentos contábeis
  • Negociação
  • Conhecimento jurídico e tributário

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We're inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we're pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You've shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you'll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You've shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don't just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder's DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You've felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn't seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Gerente de Gestão Manufatura
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Gestão Manufatura, você irá:

Com foco em vendas como ponto de partida, conformidade como base e cadeia de suprimentos e manufatura como motores principais, busca-se uma coordenação completa da cadeia para realizar o ciclo virtuoso de "pedido – produção – entrega – lucratividade". As áreas envolvidas incluem: vendas, planejamento, compras, cadeia de suprimentos, produção, qualidade, armazenagem, logística, certificações e conformidade regulatória.

  • Definir e executar a estratégia operacional anual e de longo prazo da fábrica, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos globais do grupo;
  • Otimizar os processos de produção, promovendo manufatura enxuta e melhoria contínua para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos operacionais;
  • Supervisionar o planejamento de produção, assegurando a entrega pontual dos pedidos dos clientes e atendendo às demandas do mercado;
  • Garantir que a operação da fábrica esteja em total conformidade com as regulamentações ambientais, trabalhistas, fiscais e setoriais do Brasil;
  • Manter relações com órgãos governamentais (como o Ministério Público Federal e o Ministério da Agricultura), sindicatos e associações setoriais (como a ABIMAQ e a Fenabrave), assegurando um ambiente operacional estável;
  • Liderar a identificação e qualificação de fornecedores locais (como siderúrgicas e fabricantes de componentes), negociar contratos e estabelecer parcerias de longo prazo para reduzir a dependência de importações e os custos logísticos;
  • Equilibrar os estoques de matérias-primas e produtos acabados, considerando os desafios logísticos do Brasil (como congestionamento portuário e problemas no transporte rodoviário), garantindo a disponibilidade de materiais para produção;
  • Construir e desenvolver equipes locais multidisciplinares (produção, qualidade, manutenção, recursos humanos), promovendo programas de capacitação técnica e segurança no trabalho;
  • Promover uma cultura de segurança, qualidade e comprometimento, reduzindo a rotatividade de funcionários e elevando o nível operacional;
  • Implementar sistemas de gestão da qualidade adaptados ao mercado brasileiro (como ISO 9001 e IATF 16949), supervisionando inspeções de entrada (IQC), inspeções de processo (IPQC) e inspeções de saída (OQC), reduzindo retrabalho e reclamações de clientes;
  • Monitorar os custos operacionais (mão de obra, matérias-primas, energia), liderando iniciativas de redução de custos sem comprometer a qualidade e a segurança.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Industrial ou Administração de Empresas;
  • Experiência anterior na indústria de manufatura;
  • Experiência em setores específicos como automotivo ou mecânico será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência em gestão de fábricas localizadas no Brasil ou na América Latina, com profundo conhecimento dos processos produtivos (montagem, usinagem, logística interna);
  • Familiaridade com as legislações brasileiras pertinentes, como leis trabalhistas, ambientais, tributárias e normas de segurança do trabalho;
  • Experiência na implementação de práticas de produção enxuta (Lean Manufacturing), sistemas ERP (como SAP) e ferramentas de gestão da produção (como MES);
  • Fluência em inglês ou chinês para comunicação com equipes internacionais;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos e habilidade para resolução de conflitos; experiência em negociações com fornecedores e sindicatos;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema industrial brasileiro, incluindo polos industriais e clusters de fornecedores em estados como São Paulo e Minas Gerais.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

title: Head Of Product Design (Ui/Ux, Ai-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

A HELM é uma empresa familiar com atuação global, sediada em Hamburgo, na Alemanha, com 125 anos de atuação no mercado especializado em produtos químicos, produtos para indústria farmacêutica, fertilizantes especais, defensivos agrícolas e agricultura digital. Atua em 30 países e conta com mais de 100 subsidiárias, escritórios de vendas e 1.500 funcionários.


No Brasil, a HELM atua com importação e exportação há 50 anos, comercializando soluções em proteção de cultivos para o produtor rural, além da atuação no segmento químico, desempenhando um papel relevante no mercado brasileiro. Sempre contando com fornecedores certificados e com processos produtivos com qualidade atestada. Saiba mais: br.Helmcrop.Com


Representante Comercial PJ / Sorriso - MT - CROP SOLUTIONS


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Principais Atividades:

Desenvolver a região, fortalecer a marca da HELM através da promoção de seus produtos, geração de demandas, assistência técnica, desenvolvimento dos distribuidores e/ou produtores da região, com visão de negócios para atingimento de metas em venda de produtos e serviços.

Atuar no fortalecimento de parceria e relacionamento comercial com os clientes, gerando oportunidades de negócios, atuando com venda direta e distribuidores.


Requisitos e Competências:

- Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica, com CREA e CORE ATIVOS.

- Experiência anterior na função de vendas, atendimento a distribuidores, experiência em venda direta;

- Analisar o território e determinar quais clientes mais adequados para acessar o mercado e realizar as vendas de acordo com as políticas comerciais da empresa;

- Analisar o crédito e fornecer os documentos comprovativos necessários de forma a cumprir o procedimento definido pela equipe de crédito e cobrança;

- Desenvolver um plano de negócios para a área de cobertura (região), incluindo orçamento, análise de crédito, estratégia e acesso ao mercado, análise dos clientes;

- Fazer o Forecast da área, a fim de fornecer informações para o Gestor e demais departamentos;

- Fazer visitas regulares a estes clientes de venda direta para implementação de políticas comerciais de forma a cumprir as metas de vendas, volume e targets, em alinhamento com o forecast e budget;

- Gerir as informações da região de atuação, relatórios e demais solicitações de informações feitas pela empresa;

- Identificar oportunidades e fornecer informações estratégicas para definir o melhor posicionamento do produto para sua área responsável, junto à equipe de gestão;

- Implementar posicionamento de produtos e campanhas de marketing, de acordo com as estratégias e orientações de marketing;

- Ministrar treinamentos, palestras, dias de campo em clientes chave, a fim de posicionar a empresa em alinhamento com os rumos e metas corporativas.

- Planejamento e gerenciamento de vendas;

- Execução de dias de campo e campos demonstrativos

- Conhecimento da dinâmica do mercado em cultura de soja, milho, feijão, sorgo e algodão.

- Impacto e Influência/Visão Estratégica/Iniciativa/Relacionamento/Negociação/ Organização/Resiliência/Liderança e Foco no cliente e no Resultado.

- Disponibilidade de viagens


Área de atuação : Região Sorriso - MT.

Área com alto potencial em vendas diretas e distribuidores, bem como com uma forte expansão em soja e milho como os principais cultivos, tendo como cultivos de segunda opção feijão, sorgo e algodão.

title: Agente De Negócios - Representante Comercial Pj | Frutal - Mg
description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, referência na América Latina. Com soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente, com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Contamos com o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios e o iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre na vanguarda, com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.


Seu Cardápio Diário

Nesta posição, você será o ponto de conexão entre o iFood e novos parceiros de negócios. Seu dia a dia será guiado por estratégias de expansão, conquistando novos clientes em áreas com grande potencial de crescimento.


Entre as principais responsabilidades, você irá:

  • Prospecção de novos parceiros: Identificar oportunidades de mercado e atrair restaurantes e estabelecimentos para o ecossistema iFood.
  • Gestão de funil de vendas: Realizar acompanhamento detalhado do pipeline, assegurando a conversão em cada etapa.
  • Acompanhamento contínuo: Manter contatos regulares e estruturados com potenciais clientes para estreitar relacionamentos.
  • Gestão de relacionamento: Ser referência no atendimento às demandas dos parceiros, garantindo uma experiência incrível desde o início.
  • Colaboração estratégica: Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time para maximizar resultados e impulsionar a presença do iFood na cidade de Frutal - MG .


Ingredientes que Buscamos

  • Experiência em vendas: Um diferencial será ter atuado com vendas externas, prospecção ou gestão de carteira.
  • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de Frutal - MG ou das cidades de Olímpia - SP ou Mirassol - SP e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.


Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.


Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood


Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

title: Analista Gestão De Pessoas Sr.
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

  • Apoiar os TechLeads e Coordenadores no entendimento da visão técnica das soluções.

  • Governança, auxiliar na manutenção e evolução dos templates, boilerplates e guidelines usados nos projetos.
  • Revisar documentações técnicas submetidas pelos times para garantir aderência aos padrões Roadcard.
  • Integração entre Times, facilitar a comunicação técnica entre áreas de negócio, arquitetura e desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar implementações de soluções críticas para garantir conformidade técnica
